svg.aria-label: Medical deserts — ESIEE Paris · multidisciplinary project · team. Where should France build its hospitals? A genetic algorithm written in C picks, among the 34,437 communes of mainland France, where to put hospitals so that everyone has one within 10 km, at the lowest cost. Stack: C, MLV, Python, GeoJSON.
